gloss: leading; prominent; one of the best

definitions.gloss: leading; prominent; one of the best; top-ranking
definitions.explanation: Among the very best in a group or field. The image is of counting the top items on one's fingers — so few that they can be counted on one hand.
The literal act of counting by folding fingers, often while eagerly anticipating something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧{指折|ゆびお}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名店|めいてん}→名店：21511_meiten⟧だ。
examples.english: It's one of the top restaurants in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{業界|ぎょうかい}→業界：13129_gyoukai⟧{指折|ゆびお}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{実力者|じつりょくしゃ}→実力者：21845_jitsuryokusha⟧だ。
examples.english: He is one of the leading figures in the industry.

examples.japanese: ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{指折|ゆびお}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{技術力|ぎじゅつりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧だ。
examples.english: It's a company with technological capabilities among the best in the world.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{指折|ゆびお}り⟦{数|かぞ}えて→数える：01926_kazoeru⟧⟦{待|ま}っている→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
examples.english: I'm counting the days on my fingers, waiting for the trip.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧あと⟦{何日|なんにち}→何日：23870_nannichi⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧{指折|ゆびお}り⟦{数|かぞ}えた→数える：01926_kazoeru⟧。
examples.english: I counted on my fingers how many days were left until summer vacation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{孫|まご}→孫：03731_mago⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遊|あそ}び→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧、⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{指折|ゆびお}り⟦{数|かぞ}えて→数える：01926_kazoeru⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧にして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Grandmother is counting the days until her grandchildren come to visit.

notes: Sense 1 uses the pattern 〜{指折|ゆびお}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧{指折|ゆびお}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ (one of Japan's best), ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧{指折|ゆびお}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ (among the world's best). Sense 2 uses the pattern {指折|ゆびお}り⟦{数|かぞ}える→数える：01926_kazoeru⟧ (to count on one's fingers), typically while eagerly awaiting something. Both senses derive from the image of folding fingers to count — the first implies something so exceptional it can be counted among the select few.
